title: Readiness and identity
settles: the stack is the real, non-fixture, authenticated one

steps.name: served bundle has no fixture adapter (disk scan + HTTP scan)
gateway is the live non-fixture build and the kernel is ready
unauthenticated browser sees the LoginScreen (live source label)
operator signs in through the LoginScreen; identity is the gateway-verified one
the browser loaded only live-adapter scripts (no fixture adapter at runtime)

title: Template to preflight to commit
settles: a case exists in the kernel because the UI committed it

steps.name: home offers Design case; the picker lists the published templates
select template, fill parameters; submit stays disabled before preflight
preflight passes with a digest; only then is submit enabled
editing a parameter invalidates the preflight and disables submit again
durable: commit writes case_created + item_enabled to the new case's case-events.jsonl and its plan.json
UI: the panel closes and the new case's world is the one shown
